scope: Offline native history regression on the paired physical iPhone; synthetic messages, no Host or model calls

rootCauses.cause: Pixel-level bottom preferences invalidated the screen repeatedly; each render bridged the full cached history into Kotlin and rebuilt the timeline on the main thread.
rootCauses.fix: Publish boolean visibility boundaries, capture the target outside the per-frame geometry closure, and cache an immutable projection by the full target and all semantic inputs.

rootCauses.cause: The old layout was captured after publishing the earlier page. Short lists also lost visible trailing room, so UIKit clamped the restored offset; the reproduced anchor jumped about 246pt.
rootCauses.fix: Capture layout and expand the window immediately before publishing the prefix. Preserve existing trailing room below the anchor and clear it when returning to latest.

physical.transport: Xcode/CoreDevice physical XCTest; contemporaneous wireless transport was not independently retained
physical.frameMetricDefinition: CADisplayLink intervals while the native scroll offset actually moves; not end-to-end touch latency or a guaranteed frame rate.
physical.execution: separate test-without-building repeat of the unchanged frozen native build
physical.baselineEvidenceLimit: Baseline preceded the cache and geometry fixes and used the same optimized native fixture. Its xcresult and trace are retained privately; the exact original baseline source snapshot was not retained.

notAcceptedTrials.reason: The unchanged frozen build again needed target reactivation and missed a native pan. The failed result remains separate from the later uninterrupted accepted repeat.
Snapshot did not retain executable permission on the shared-core build script. Fixed by preserving source file modes.

Native XCTest logs show target reactivations during measurement. The origin of the foreground changes is unconfirmed. This failed run remains preserved and is not accepted as an uninterrupted performance result.

liveHistory.observation: iOS reported no usable network during the real HTTPS attempt. User requested offline regression first.

otherPlatforms.android: no new native acceptance; shared production algorithm unchanged

deviceEvidenceAuditLimit: Exact destination verified against the designated iPhone 15; this does not extend the original run to later modified source.
